column3: “Elect sojourners of the Dispersion” is rendered “those who reside as aliens, scattered,” with “who are chosen” moved to the end.
“Unto the obedience and sprinkling of the blood” is rendered “that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with His blood”; “be multiplied” is rendered “be yours in fullest measure.”
“Having begotten us again” is rendered “has caused us to be born again.”
NASB follows the critical text (“for you”); it supplies “to obtain.”
“Guarded” is rendered “protected.”
NASB adds “even though.”
NASB follows the critical text (“more precious”); “proven genuineness” is rendered “proof,” and “refined” “tested.”
NASB follows the critical text (“have not seen”); it supplies “Him.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB supplies “that would come.”
“What or what manner of time” is rendered “what person or time.”
NASB follows the critical text (“but you”); “proclaimed” is rendered “announced,” and NASB supplies “things.”
“Girded up the loins of your mind” is rendered “gird your minds for action.”
“Children of obedience” is rendered “obedient children,” and “desires” “lusts.”
“Conduct” is rendered “behavior.”
NASB follows the critical text (“You shall be holy”).
“Call on” is rendered “address,” and “sojourn” “stay upon earth.”
“Handed down from your fathers” is rendered “inherited from your forefathers.”
NASB supplies “the blood of.”
“Revealed” is rendered “appeared”; NASB adds “For He was.”
NASB follows the critical text (“believers”).
NASB follows the critical text, without “through the Spirit”; “out of a pure heart” is rendered “from the heart.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “forever”; it adds “that is.”
NASB follows the critical text (“its glory”).
“Declaration” is rendered “word,” and “evangelised” “preached.”
